get.description: Retrieves selected fields from records in a specific Airtable table.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: filterByFormula
parameters.description:
Leave blank to return all records in this table. If the record has a blank value for one of the fields specified below, the field is omitted from the response. Wrap column names in curly brackets ({}) and use single quotes ('') to wrap string and date values.

Example: {SKU} = '12345'

schema.description:
Leave blank to return all records in this table. If the record has a blank value for one of the fields specified below, the field is omitted from the response. Wrap column names in curly brackets ({}) and use single quotes ('') to wrap string and date values.

Example: {SKU} = '12345'

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: The Field Names or Field Id to return in the response. (case-sensitive)

schema.description: The Field Names or Field Id to return in the response. (case-sensitive)

parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

put.description: Updates multiple records in a specific Airtable table, or upserts them when enabled.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

records[].description: Airtable records array (max 10). Each item must include an id and a fields object.

records[].id.description: Airtable record ID (rec...). Row number is not accepted.
records[].id.example: recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX (required for updates; get from List Records)

records[].fields.description: JSON object with field names as keys, e.g. {"name":"Updated"}.
